questions.stem:
—I ______ my homework already. Can I watch TV now?
—Yes, but you must finish cleaning your room first.
questions.explanation: 选C。already（已经）是现在完成时的标志性时间状语，表示动作已经完成并对现在造成影响（可以看电视了）。A是一般现在时，表示经常性动作；B是一般过去时，只表示过去发生过，与already连用不恰当；D是一般将来时。口诀：现完标志有already/yet/ever/never/since/for。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: This is the museum ______ we visited last year.
questions.explanation: 选B。先行词museum是物，在定语从句中作visited的宾语，关系代词用which或that。who指人且作主语；whom指人且作宾语；whose表示所属关系（谁的），在从句中作定语。技巧：先行词是物用which/that，是人用who/whom/that。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The old bridge ______ by the government next month.
questions.explanation: 选D。next month表示将来时间，bridge（桥）是repair（修理）的承受者，所以用一般将来时的被动语态：will be + 过去分词。A是一般现在时主动；B是一般过去时；C是一般将来时主动语态，缺少被动。技巧：看到by短语或主语是物+动作，考虑被动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to Hong Kong?
—Yes, I went there last summer.
questions.explanation: 选C。ever（曾经）是现在完成时的标志词，询问是否有过某种经历，用have been to（去过某地）。答句虽然用了一般过去时（went）回答具体时间，但问句强调对现在的影响（有没有这个经历）。A是一般过去时，不与ever连用；B是一般现在时；D是现在进行时表将来。难点：答句的过去时容易误导考生选A，但问句的时间标志ever决定用现在完成时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: If you ______ something, you try to find information about it.
questions.explanation: 选B。根据句意'试图找到关于某事的信息'，research（研究、调查）最符合语境。repeat（重复）、recycle（回收）、remember（记得）均不符合'查找信息'的含义。技巧：通过定语从句的解释功能猜测词义。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 选A。im-是否定前缀，加在possible（可能的）前构成反义词impossible（不可能的）。其他选项：important（重要的），polite（礼貌的），patient（耐心的）均与impossible的词根不符。常见否定前缀：un-/in-/im-/dis-/ir-。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: When you ______ old clothes, you give them to people who need them.
questions.explanation: 选C。give away表示'捐赠、赠送'，符合'给需要的人'的语境。put away（收好、放好），take up（开始从事、占据），look up（查阅、向上看）。技巧：give away中的away有'离开、向外'的含义，引申为'送出去'。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 选A。through表示'通过、凭借（某种方式）'，teach sb. through sth. 表示'通过某事教某人'。past（经过），across（横穿，指平面），over（越过，指上方）。此处指'通过实践工作'，用through。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Last spring, our school started an interesting project - building a green garden on the rooftop. The idea came from our science teacher, Mr. Li. He wanted to teach us about environmental protection (8)______ practical work.

At first, we knew nothing about gardening. Mr. Li invited some experts to give us lessons on how to plant vegetables. We learned that soil (9)______ is very important. We also needed to make sure the plants got enough sunlight and water.

The most challenging part was building the watering system. We decided to use (10)______ water from the air conditioning system. This not only saved water but also reduced waste. My classmates and I worked together every Friday afternoon. (11)______ we felt tired after school, everyone was excited to see the plants growing.

Three months later, we harvested our first vegetables. The tomatoes and lettuce tasted delicious! Through this project, we not only learned scientific knowledge but also understood the importance of teamwork and environmental protection. It was really a (12)______ experience for all of us.

questions.explanation: 选B。quality（质量），soil quality（土壤质量）是种植蔬菜的关键因素。price（价格），color（颜色），weight（重量）虽然也是土壤的属性，但在种植语境下，土壤质量最重要。技巧：根据上下文'种植蔬菜'和'很重要'判断应选quality。

questions.stem: Why did Bosco invent the alarm clock?
options: A. Because he wanted to win a competition.
B. Because he was often late for school.
C. Because his father asked him to do so.
D. Because he wanted to help deaf people.
questions.explanation: 选B。细节理解题。根据第一段第二句'Bosco... used to be late for school because he couldn't hear his alarm clock'可知，他因为听不到闹钟经常迟到，所以发明了这种闹钟。A是后来的结果，C文中未提及父亲要求，D是他希望帮助的人群但不是最初的发明原因。技巧：细节题要定位原文具体句子，避免主观推断。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you have trouble waking up in the morning? Bosco, a 14-year-old student from Shenzhen, used to be late for school because he couldn't hear his alarm clock. Instead of complaining, he decided to solve this problem creatively.

Last year, Bosco invented a special alarm clock called "Shake-Awake". Different from traditional alarm clocks that only make noise, this device has a vibrating (震动的) pad that goes under the pillow. When it's time to wake up, the pad vibrates gently but strongly enough to wake even heavy sleepers.

"The idea came to me when I learned about sound waves in physics class," Bosco explained. "I realized that vibration travels through solids better than sound travels through air. So even if someone can't hear well, they can still feel the vibration."

Bosco spent three months building the prototype (原型). He faced many difficulties, especially with programming the timing system. With help from his father and online tutorials, he finally succeeded. Now he never misses the school bus.

His invention won first prize in the city youth science competition. The judges praised his creative thinking and practical problem-solving skills. Bosco hopes to improve the design and help more people who are deaf or hard of hearing.

"It doesn't matter how old you are," Bosco said. "If you observe carefully and keep trying, you can make a difference."

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. Bosco is good at physics and programming.
B. Bosco's father is a science teacher.
C. The invention is only useful for deaf people.
D. Bosco sold his invention to a company.
questions.explanation: 选A。推理判断题。根据第三段提到'learned about sound waves in physics class'（物理课学习声波）和第四段'especially with programming the timing system'（编写计时程序）可推断Bosco擅长物理和编程。B文中未提及父亲职业；C错误，原文说'even heavy sleepers'也能用，不只是聋人；D文中未提及卖发明。技巧：推理题要基于原文信息合理推断，不能过度推断或选择文中明确否定/未提及的选项。

questions.explanation: 选A。词义猜测题。根据上下文'goes under the pillow'（放在枕头下）和'wake even heavy sleepers'（唤醒熟睡的人）以及后文'feel the vibration'（感受震动）可知，这是通过持续的小震动来唤醒人，而不是声音、光或热。技巧：利用上下文线索（under the pillow, feel）和常识（枕头下能感受到的是震动）猜测词义。

questions.stem: What's the best title for the passage?
options: A. How to Make an Alarm Clock
B. A Boy Who Likes Sleeping
C. A Young Inventor's Creative Solution
D. The Importance of Physics Class
questions.explanation: 选C。主旨大意题。文章主要讲述了14岁学生Bosco发明震动闹钟解决自己迟到问题的故事，强调年轻发明家的创意和解决问题的能力。A只是细节，不是主旨；B与文意相反（他不是喜欢睡觉而是醒不来）；D只是灵感来源之一。技巧：主旨题要涵盖全文主要内容，不能太大也不能太片面，通常关注首尾段和反复出现的关键词（invented, creative, solution）。
